title: 05 · Toast stack (Kinroom)
strengths: The behaviour is right and specific: newest in front, 14 px lift and 5% scale per layer, a timer bar only on auto-dismiss toasts, Undo that stays, Retry on the failed upload, Reply on a mention
Copy reads like a product: 'Huddle notes saved · Pinned to #launch-week', 'roadmap-q3.pdf didn't upload · The connection dropped at 62%'
One face (Figtree), one accent, the display line highlighted by weight only
slop_signals: Two blurred fog blobs (lilac top-right, mint bottom-left) behind the whole sheet: gradient blobs for no reason

Every toast opens with a tinted icon disc (mint check, lilac undo arrow, rose '!', a pink-to-lilac gradient 'T' avatar); real toasts carry meaning with a 16 px icon or a 3 px bar, not a 40 px pastel circle
Toasts are 356 px wide with 24 px corners, pill buttons and a 3-line stack: three white pillows the size of cards, while Asana, Skiff and Notion Mail ship 180 to 280 px, one-line toasts

The chat behind uses pastel-circle initials ('AI', 'MK', 'A', 'T', 'M') and the left column is a marketing page ('Small news, softly stacked.') explaining the component, so the toast never appears at product scale
fixes: Flatten the background to one lilac-grey; delete both blobs
Replace the icon discs with a plain 16 px icon in the status colour (or a 3 px left bar), and the gradient avatar with a neutral monogram
Shrink toasts to about 320 px, 12 to 16 px radius, 12 px padding, title 14 px and body 13 px; make Undo and Mark read text buttons, keep one filled button (Reply)
Render the hero as the chat app at real scale with the stack in its corner; move the explainer copy to the notes

references.what: A small bottom-left toast with a green time bar and a plain 'Undo' button; no icon disc, no shadow stack
A dark 180 px toast: 'Message sent', one line, 'Undo'; shows how small a real toast is
'Thread archived · Undo' as a single dark pill, bottom left, in the page's own corner
White toast with a small check icon, title and one-line body at bottom right; the closest in size to ours and still quieter
Success toast with a 16 px icon and a close, on the app's own surface

changed: Rebuilt as the Kinroom app at real size: a publisher's room with Kinroom's own labels and a room brief panel (print run, reading seats, advance copies, pinned call notes, a checklist with owners and dates)
Fog blobs, pastel icon discs, pillow toasts and the marketing column removed; ink one-line toasts, 288 px, in the window corner over the brief, stepped tones behind
Toast behaviour kept from the house standards; the timer stays on the plain toast because action toasts persist (STD-15, WCAG 2.2.1)
Story and data made consistent; people renamed to avoid 'AI' and 'DM' initials and a fictional detective; Thimbleweed Press became Pellwick Press
States: expanded, mention, error (failure kept on the composer chip); the redundant uploading frame removed
Fresh-eyes audit 3/5, then 4/5; remaining notes fixed
Renamed Chorus to Kinroom (coordinator, 2026-10-15): the old name belongs to real products in the same field; web search found no Kinroom

Presentation: real-size app (14 px) at 1.25x with icon rail and top bar; the first 1.5x table version failed the blind test (Laravel -3) and was replaced
Board counts add up to 296; moved candidates shown in Onsite; scorecard dots only where scorecards are collected
One accent job (green = work running); ink primary; cool greys via Q-color-09
Engine: re-sketched as Panelwise, Figtree, base size 14, dials lowered
Stale extra frames (shot-error, shot-expanded, shot-mention) deleted; 'LinkedIn' removed
Per PRESENTATION.md: shown at 1x (the 1.25x crop removed); board columns filled so no dead quarter; no hanging close button, no undefined dots, one toast button style, one date format
